glasses_felix: Previous assumption of bedroom desk for early morning is incorrect. On day 20, it was at bathroom_shelf_ba1 at 07:30. The glasses are in the bathroom during the morning routine, not the bedroom. Do not guess desk_b1 or nightstand_b1 before 09:00. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 for early morning queries. Evening pattern remains valid: check armchair_l1 or coffee_table_l1 after 20:00.

tablet_felix: Previous assumption of static kitchen or living room location is incorrect. The tablet follows Felix’s movement closely. On day 20, it was at kitchen_table_k1 at 08:15 (breakfast), moved to coffee_table_l1 by 11:23 (mid-day), and was at bed_b1 by 21:56 (night). Do not guess nightstand_b1 for morning. Do not assume it stays in the living room all day. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning (07:00-09:00), coffee_table_l1 for mid-day (10:00-18:00), and bed_b1 for late evening (after 20:00).

mug_felix: Previous note remains relevant. On day 19, it moved from cupboard_k1 to coffee_table_l1 by 09:21. The mug follows Felix’s morning routine: starts in the kitchen (cupboard or counter) before 09:00, then moves to the living room. Do not guess kitchen spots after 09:00. Check cupboard_k1 for very early morning (before 08:30) and coffee_table_l1 for late morning and afternoon.

book_felix: Previous note remains relevant. On day 19, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 10:29. The book remains anchored to the coffee table during the day. Do not guess couch_l1 or armchair_l1 unless there is specific evidence of a move to seating. Coffee_table_l1 is the reliable default for mid-day and early evening queries.

water_bottle_felix: Previous note remains relevant. On day 19, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 14:24. The bottle is not a kitchen item; it stays in the living room with Felix. Do not guess kitchen spots. Check coffee_table_l1 for all daytime queries.

General Note: Felix’s items show a strong bias toward the living room coffee_table_l1 during the day, but the tablet is an exception that moves to the bedroom at night. Morning routines involve the kitchen (mug, tablet) and bathroom (glasses). Avoid guessing bedroom spots for morning queries. For mid-day and afternoon, prioritize coffee_table_l1 for books, mugs, water bottles, and tablets. In the evening, check living room seating for glasses and the bedroom bed for the tablet.
